events.title: Update 0.1.109: Every Power Shines
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing the demo during Next Fest! Update 0.1.109 is out for the full game and the demo, and it's all about making every moment feel better. Every power shows what it does Bubbles, Whirlwind, Paper Plane, Slow Motion, Messenger and the ground coins are now easy to see while they're active. events.title: Pidgeon Pocket is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is open, and our pigeons have been waiting all week for a crowd this big. Pidgeon Pocket is a cute, chill heist incremental. You aim your flock at a park full of picnickers, snatch the coins out of their pockets and fly back before the police catch on. Every pigeon wears its own superpower, charged by stealing, and every level lays an egg with three choices inside: a new power, a stronger one or a bag of coins. events.title: Pidgeon Pocket is now on Google Play
events.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is out now on Android! Get Pidgeon Pocket on Google Play Tap someone in the crowd and a pigeon dives for their pocket. Spend the loot on the upgrade tree, hatch a superpower for every pigeon and go again. 20 superpowers, one per pigeon, with 5 levels each An egg to hatch every level, with three choices inside A flock of up to five pigeons and 13 pigeon tiers to climb It's free to play. events.title: SUPERPOWERS
events.summary: Now your pigeons have superpowers. Every pigeon in your flock wears a power of its own, and it charges each time that pigeon steals. When it is full, click the pigeon or its face at the bottom of the screen and the power goes off. Leave it and it fires by itself a moment later. Charged by stealing Each power has its own moment. events.title: The Pidgeon Pocket demo is live. Go pick some pockets.
events.summary: It is out, and it is free. Grab the demo, send your pigeons down from the rooftop, and lift coins straight out of the crowd’s pockets. What you can do in the demo: Send pigeons into the park and swipe coins from unsuspecting park-goers. Spend your loot on a skill tree full of cheeky upgrades. Grow your flock and keep the heists rolling. Read the crowd: races, parades and speeches roll through, and the police are watching. Runs on Windows, Mac, Linux and Steam Deck. Like it? events.title: Pidgeon Pocket now runs on Mac, Linux and Steam Deck
events.summary: Good news for the flock. Pidgeon Pocket runs natively on macOS and Linux now, and it's Steam Deck ready. Wherever you sit down to play, your pigeons are ready to work the park and pocket a few coins. The free demo lands on July 24. No cost, no catch. Give it a spin on Windows, Mac, Linux or your Deck before you buy. Wishlist Pidgeon Pocket and Steam will ping you the moment the demo goes live: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4852570/
